note: 12 banks is not a power of two, so 32 consecutive stick reads visit each bank only ~2.7 times - most set_state calls pay full price and the grouping bookkeeping is pure added cost.

mechanism: page->bank is page_id % num_banks (12). On every R==1 geometry every core shares start_page, so the helper ascending stick loop puts all 64 cores on the SAME bank at the same instant for 32 steps. Rotating the issue order per core is free: all 32 reads sit behind one barrier and each lands at its own L1 offset, so the block is bit-identical.

finding: premise confirmed (writer_wait_out -29%) but priced above value: halving the read doubles NoC commands (+1935ns reader) and lengthens writer_barrier (+2180ns). Shipped MIN_BLOCK_ROW_BYTES=512 / PIPELINE_WAVES_PER_CORE=4 select the measured-best rung on all 7 geometries.
overlap and tail-flattening both REAL (writer_wait_out 63.7%->41.9%, NCRISC tail 1.44x->1.05x) and worth nothing: writer_issue scales LINEARLY with blocks/core. Rule regresses 0.72x on [1,1,32,2048].

hazard: posted writes have NO landing fence in the API (noc_async_posted_writes_flushed and noc_async_full_barrier both only wait posted_writes_SENT) so program completion would not imply the DRAM output is complete

finding: decisive: writer_wait_first 6091ns ~= reader_read_block 5300ns, writer_wait_rest 37ns. The writer is starved by the READ, not by the compute->writer push quantum; the entire budget of a finer push is 66-89 ns of a 12.4us wall. Split read barrier -19.0% on [1,1,16384,32].

core-time tail is a MONOTONE GRADIENT IN PHYSICAL GRID ROW (NCRISC row means 7227..2982 ns on identical work), attached to the physical core not the block: corr(duration,grid_row)=-0.97 survives every permutation while corr(duration,block_id) flips sign. Not dispatch skew (START spread 190ns vs END spread 4.6-7.6us). Not bank phase (corr=-0.01). max/mean is permutation-invariant.

dependency-free reconstruction of the focus shape traffic reaches 11152 ns / 188 GB/s at the op forced 512-B read (10751 / 195 GB/s at 2-KB reads). Op at 12356 = 1.108x off. Gap decomposition: compute+2nd CB hop 483 ns (30%), read->write DEPENDENCY 721 ns (45%), transaction size 401 ns (25%, inexpressible at 64-core occupancy). Mechanism: the two NoCs positional gradients have OPPOSITE sign (NCRISC r=-0.91, BRISC r=+0.83 with grid row) so in the independent rung read and write tails anti-phase; the dependency INVERTS the BRISC gradient to -0.91 and stacks both tails on the same cores.
action: reframes the round: op is NOT at its roofline, but every known breaker of the dependency has now been measured and lost

finding: M1 confirmed. Per-row regression duration[y] ~ a[y] + b[y]*w[y] gives a-share 67-75% on the slow rows: they are WAITING not working. Moving one tile of width from row 0 to row 7 saves 351 ns and costs 1208 ns - a 3.4x losing exchange. Polarity irrelevant (wide-to-slow control ties or beats wide-to-fast). grad_brisc 0.944x, grad_full 0.950x.
